title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Waste
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Waste. Substances or objects which are discarded, are intended to be discarded or are required to be discarded in accordance with national laws. Waste is a potential resource or commodity that could be turned into a useful product, recycled or recovered (source: ISO 24161:2022). See also envo:00002264. Subclass of s4envi:Resource (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.12); location is inherited from the Resource model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Waste'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

isProducedBy.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/isProducedBy'. Waste is produced by a waste producer. (ontology restriction: minimum 1). Links to WasteProducer entities.

isDepositedIn.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/isDepositedIn'. Waste is deposited in one container. (ontology restriction: exactly 1). Links to a Container entity.

isDepositedAt.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/isDepositedAt'. Waste is deposited at a waste processing site. (ontology restriction: exactly 1). Links to a WasteProcessingSite entity.

becomes.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/becomes'. Waste becomes either a secondary raw resource, or final waste. Links to a SecondaryRawResource or FinalWaste entity.

isProcessedBy.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/isProcessedBy'. Waste is processed by at least one waste processing device. (ontology restriction: minimum 1). Links to WasteProcessingDevice entities.

isCollectedDuring.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/isCollectedDuring'. Waste is collected during a journey. (ontology restriction: maximum 1). Links to a Journey entity.

processingBeginsOn.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/processingBeginsOn'. Waste begins being processed on a given date.

processingEndsOn.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/processingEndsOn'. Waste ends being processed on a given date.

hasCollectionDate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/hasCollectionDate'. Waste has one collection date, the date on which it was initially collected. (ontology restriction: maximum 1).

wasteKind.description: Property. Open/enumerated vocabulary, flattened from saref:hasFeatureKind whose range is s4envi:WasteKind -- not modelled as its own entity. Known individuals (non-exhaustive): 'BiodegradableWaste', 'FoodWaste', 'GardenParkWaste', 'ConstructionWaste', 'ConcreteConstructionWaste', 'WoodConstructionWaste', 'WoodWaste', 'GlassWaste', 'HouseholdWaste', 'PaperCardboardWaste', 'PlasticWaste', 'TextileWaste'.
